entity: Mr. J. M. Reynolds, Member of Governor's Mining Adversary Board, State of Nevada
summary: Mr. J. M. Reynolds, a member of Nevada's Governor's Mining Advisory Board, urged that ORV regulations take into account four-wheel drive vehicles used in mining, prospecting, and ranching. His comment was part of a broader group of mining-related responses that led the Department to revise its definition of off-road vehicles to except mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment. The log indicates his response was a one-page letter (identified as 'L') submitted on July 5, 1972.
summary_quote: Mr. J. M. Reynolds, Member of Governor's Mining Adversary Board, State of Nevada - urged that ORV regulations take into consideration four-wheel drive vehicles in field of mining, prospecting, and ranching.
